title: Underground Marvels
description:
S02 E01 — Hotel Bunker of the Apocalypse
The top-secret construction of a massive nuclear bunker remained concealed under a palatial West Virginia hotel for decades; experts reveal how this vast subterranean structure was one of the most closely guarded Cold War secrets in U.S. history.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S08 E05 — Secrets of Time Travel
Time travel may be more possible now than ever imagined, and today, cutting-edge technology and the latest research into black holes and wormholes is helping experts get much closer to discovering how to travel through time.

title: How the Universe Works

Investigators reveal the secret history of U.S. presidents and UFOs, from President Franklin D. Roosevelt's knowledge about a UFO battle over Los Angeles to President John F. Kennedy's alleged plan to share extraterrestrial secrets with the Russians.

title: UFOs: The Lost Evidence
description:
S02 E09 — Native Americans and Star People
Native American myths are steeped in the otherworldly, but new evidence and modern-day UFO sightings have experts rethinking these legends and depictions.

title: Phantom Signals
description:
S01 E05 — The Ghost on the Radio
When someone picks up a radio distress call from a seven-year-old boy lost alone in the desert, authorities embark on a search-and-rescue mission to find him; as the hunt continues, the case becomes more and more mysterious.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E04 — King Thutmose II Tomb & Secret Saudi Gates
Look inside the lost tomb of King Thutmose II and get new clues about Egypt's pharaohs; dust off stone hunting structures in Saudi Arabia; visit a 1,200-year-old mosque buried in the Negev Desert and inspect a 30-million-year-old predator skull.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
Million Mummy Necropolis and the Enigmatic Horseshoe
From a cemetery in Egypt to ancient bones on a Welsh beach, ancient burial sites illuminate forgotten lives and long-lost cultural shifts.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E07 — Screaming Mummy and Chaco Canyon Highway
Ponder the fate of a mummy buried with an anguished look on its face; learn the secret to Sumerian power in a buried Iraqi palace; visit a lost oasis that may rewrite Arabian history; travel New Mexican roads that align with the heavens.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E06 — Forgotten Mongol Soldiers and an Ancient Iraqi Tavern
Inspect a Mongolian mass grave and learn the fate of a platoon of soldiers, then investigate a 5,000-year-old tavern in Iraq; examine an Egyptian scarab that's far from home and ancient tools that show where desert migration routes once lay.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E05 — Drowned Stone Age Fisherman
Scan the skeleton of a drowned Stone Age fisherman in Chile and rediscover a vanished golden age in Egypt's lost city of Aten; ancient Chinese mummies reignite a cultural debate; discover a massive biblical-era moat in Jerusalem.

title: Secrets in the Sand
description:
S02 E01 — The Atacama \"Alien\" Skeleton
Examine a tiny skeleton in Chile that set off a firestorm of alien speculation; explore a forgotten Silk Road settlement; uncover evidence of a mass sacrifice in northern Peru and visit a multi-faceted military site from the age of the pharaohs.

title: Strange Evidence
description:
S05 E08 — Revenge of the Monster Wolf
Footage of a wolf-like creature in the remote wilderness of northern Canada could be evidence of a dire wolf, a prehistoric beast that went extinct at the end of the last Ice Age; experts use cutting-edge technology to investigate if it has returned.

title: Strange Evidence
description:

A close encounter with an enraged ape-like creature is caught on camera, experts investigate if it's evidence of a once-extinct Neanderthal specimen engineered by a nearby experimental research facility.

A boy who can turn his head 180 degrees and face directly behind him resembles infamous accounts of demonic possession from horror films; experts use cutting-edge technology to find out what's giving him this extreme ability.

description:

S01 E01 — Buried Beneath Jerusalem
Lost for centuries, scholars believe the Ark of the Covenant never left Jerusalem and remains buried beneath this ancient city; now, a pioneering team of archaeologists is on a quest to unearth the most famous and treasured artifact in human history.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E02 — Heist in the Holy Land
Ancient documents and legends suggest that the Ark of the Covenant may have been stolen by Roman legions and hidden in Rome; a team of archaeologists explores mystery cults and ancient catacombs to uncover the truth behind this treasured artifact.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E06 — The Doomsday Curse
Ancient scriptures describe the Ark of the Covenant as possessing an almighty force with the capacity to kill; now, an expert team of archaeologists traces the ark's destructive path in a quest to discover the truth behind its mythical power.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E04 — The Jeremiah Code
According to biblical scripture, the prophet Jeremiah hides the Ark of the Covenant at a remote location for safekeeping; a team of archaeologists investigates sacred sites and ancient tombs to retrace the possible journey of this lost artifact.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E05 — Legend of the Knights Templar
The holy order of the Knights Templar are believed to have located and seized the Ark of the Covenant centuries ago; now, expert historians follow the trail of this elusive order to uncover the truth behind this sacred relic's mysterious journey.

title: Secrets of the Lost Ark
description:
S01 E07 — Mysteries of Ethiopia's Ark
Some allege that the Ark of the Covenant was stolen by King Solomon's son and taken to Ethiopia thousands of years ago; now, archaeologists investigate new, mysterious leads to uncover the secrets behind this lost relic's elusive journey.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S12 E09 — Secrets of Biosphere 2
Satellite images capture a mysterious group of pyramid-shaped structures in the arid, desert landscape of Arizona; experts investigate a highly controversial research facility designed to prepare humanity for life on another world.
